purpose: Detect whether a Minecraft Java client instance has a known schematic/projection provider and which file formats it handles.

dependencies.notes: MaLiLib is required by the Litematica builds covered by this rule; verify against the exact JAR metadata.

notes: Litematica targets Fabric for Minecraft 1.14+; the original project also has a Forge build for 1.12.2.
Do not treat a differently named port as Litematica; third-party ports have separate mod ids.
Forgematica is an unofficial (Neo)Forge port of Litematica.
Validate loader and Minecraft compatibility from the exact installed artifact.
WorldEdit reads and writes .schem (Sponge) and legacy .schematic (MCEdit) files.
For modded clients the schematic folder is config/worldedit/schematics.
Project-level loader lists do not prove every release supports every loader/Minecraft combination.
Create loads .nbt structures from the instance's schematics folder through the Schematic Table.
The published Create project targets Forge/NeoForge; a separately published Fabric port exists. Validate the exact artifact.
Do not hard-code Flywheel as required when the exact Create artifact bundles it.
Axiom blueprints are .bp files stored under config/axiom/blueprints.
The published Axiom project targets Fabric and requires Fabric API.
Blueprint structure is not publicly specified in a stable, verifiable form; ECL reports the format as unverified and must not parse or preview it as NBT.
